metadata.name: Sports Car Dashboard Menu
metadata.description: A night-time driver's seat view as a navigation menu: press and hold the ignition key to crank and start the engine, watch the needles sweep and the cluster light up, rev it, honk the horn, and use the steering wheel buttons as page links. Some starts fail with a flat battery or a flooded backfire. Synthesized engine sound.
metadata.author: aakashmehra
